judge_response:
ANALYSIS: Vestibular neuritis is inflammation of the vestibular nerve causing isolated acute vestibular dysfunction (vertigo, imbalance) without cochlear symptoms, while labyrinthitis involves the entire labyrinth and typically includes hearing loss and/or tinnitus in addition to vertigo. These are related peripheral vestibular disorders but are distinct clinical entities, so the prediction is not equivalent to the reference.

VERDICT: INCORRECT
